result.description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) lets businesses send/receive WhatsApp messages, manage templates, phone numbers and webhooks programmatically.
result.auth_detail: Cloud API calls use Bearer access tokens: short-lived user tokens (dev only), long-lived System User tokens for own business, and Business Integration System User tokens via Embedded Signup for Tech Providers/partners serving customers. Facebook Login for Business OAuth is used for onboarding and the Meta MCP.
result.access_detail: Free self-serve for own WABA: create Meta app, business portfolio, system user token, accept ToS, 2-step verification (test number available). For a multi-tenant toolkit where end users connect their own WABAs, Advanced access via App Review plus Business Verification (and Tech Provider/Embedded Signup) is required. Messaging itself is per-message conversation priced. Review-gate details are from search summary, not verified on a fetched page.
result.api_notes: Graph API (graph.facebook.com/vXX.X) REST endpoints: send messages (text/media/template/interactive), message templates, phone numbers, WABA management, business profile, media, QR codes, flows, payments, analytics, subscribed apps/webhooks. Inbound messages via webhooks.
result.blocker: Multi-tenant use by end users needs Meta App Review (Advanced access) and Business Verification; Embedded Signup for Tech Provider onboarding. Single-account bearer-token use is self-serve.

evidence.quote: When making API requests, include your token in an authorization request header, preceded by `Bearer`.
System tokens rely on system users.
This is because user access tokens expire quickly, so you have to keep generating a new one every few hours.
Use WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for WhatsApp accounts, phone numbers, templates, webhooks, and test messages.
This release is built for development and testing workflows, not production sending at scale.
